# Checkout, Payment, Shipping & Order Flow — Secomm Launchpad

<!-- Generated by Secomm Production AI Toolkit -->

> **Purpose**: Document the checkout flow. Note Hyvä checkout differences vs standard Luma checkout.

---

## Checkout Flow

> **NOTE**: This project uses **Mageplaza One Step Checkout (OSC)**, NOT the Hyvä React checkout. The default Magento checkout is fully replaced by the Mageplaza Osc/OscPro/OscUltimate family. `hyva-themes/magento2-luma-checkout` (1.1.7) is present as a compat layer but the active checkout is Mageplaza OSC.

| Step | Description | Custom? | Hyvä? | Risk |
|------|-------------|---------|-------|------|
| 1. Cart | Mageplaza QuickCart available; ExtraFee + DeliveryTime may surface in totals | Yes | Yes (Hyvä cart template) | M |
| 2. Checkout entry | Mageplaza One Step Checkout — single-page flow (billing + shipping + payment on one page) | Yes | Yes | H |
| 3. Address entry | Secomm_AddressDropdown AJAX hierarchical dropdowns: country → state/province → city/district → sub-city/ward (VN data via Secomm_VietNamAddress) | Yes | Yes | M |
| 4. Shipping method | Mageplaza TableRate (`mptablerate`, default inactive) — dimensional L/W/H factor 5000; plus any default Magento carriers | Yes | Yes | M |
| 5. Delivery time | Mageplaza DeliveryTime selection | Yes | Yes | L |
| 6. Extra fee | Mageplaza ExtraFee surcharge shown in totals | Yes | Yes | M |
| 7. Payment | Mollie (active) or VNPAY (default inactive) — see Payment Methods | Yes | Yes (Mollie Hyvä compat bundle) | H |
| 8. Place order | Mageplaza OSC places order → payment redirect/inline → return/info → IPN (VNPAY) | Yes | Yes | H |
| 9. Thank-you page | Mageplaza ThankYouPage | Yes | Yes | L |

### Hyvä Checkout Notes

- **Checkout type**: Mageplaza One Step Checkout (Osc/OscPro/OscUltimate). NOT the Hyvä React checkout. `hyva-themes/magento2-luma-checkout` 1.1.7 present as compat fallback.
- **Hyvä Theme version**: 3.x (default theme 1.5.2)
- **Customizations**: VN hierarchical address dropdowns (Secomm_AddressDropdown), ExtraFee totals, DeliveryTime selection, Mollie + VNPAY payment
- **Billing/Shipping**: Mageplaza OSC handles billing/shipping on a single page; VNPAY uses redirect (Pay → hosted page → Order/Info return → Order/Ipn IPN). Mollie uses module-owned redirect/inline + webhook.

## Payment Methods

| Method | Module | Hyvä Compat? | Risk |
|--------|--------|-------------|------|
| Mollie | `mollie/magento2` 3.1.1 (+ `mollie/magento2-hyva-compatibility` 3.1.0) | Yes | H (payment) |
| VNPAY | `Secomm_VNPAY` (custom, app/code) — default `active=0` | TBD (custom UI) | H (payment/IPN/signature) |
| Braintree | Bundled (Magento core) | TBD | M |
| PayPal | Bundled (Magento core) | TBD | M |

> **Payment escalation**: Any change to Secomm_VNPAY (payment/IPN/signature) requires SA review (Tier 2). Payment logging must never include PAN/CVV/full cardholder+expiry (PCI DSS 3.4).

## Shipping Methods

| Method | Carrier Code | Hyvä Compat? | Risk |
|--------|-------------|-------------|------|
| Mageplaza TableRate | `mptablerate` | Yes | M |
| Flat rate | `flatrate` (Magento core) | Yes | L |
| Table rate (core) | `tablerate` (Magento core) | Yes | L |
| Free shipping | `freeshipping` (Magento core) | Yes | L |

> **Note**: Mageplaza TableRate (`mptablerate`) is **default inactive**. Dimensional attributes (length/width/height) with shipping factor **5000**. Enable + configure before use.

## Order State Machine

Standard Magento order states apply. Payment-specific deviations to watch:

| Transition | Trigger | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| `new` (pending) → `processing` | Payment capture confirmed | Mollie webhook or VNPAY IPN (signature-validated, idempotent) |
| `processing` → `complete` | Ship + invoice | Standard Magento |
| `processing` → `closed` / `new` → `canceled` | Decline / cancellation | VNPAY decline must be signature-validated before state change |
| Any manual state change | SA-approved only | **[BLOCK]** never set `order.state` to a value not in the state transition map without `setState()` + a comment naming the business reason |

> **[BLOCK]** VNPAY IPN must be idempotent (unique event/transaction id + unique index) — reject duplicate processing on retry. Any code that sets order state from an IPN payload must re-validate signature + amount + currency server-side.

---

## High-Risk Touchpoints

| Touchpoint | Why High-Risk |
|------------|---------------|
| VNPAY IPN controller (`Controller/Order/Ipn`) | Signature validation + idempotency + order state mutation — PCI-sensitive |
| VNPAY Pay redirect (`Controller/Order/Pay`) | Request signature construction; amount/currency integrity |
| Mageplaza OSC checkout flow | Complex single-page flow replacing default checkout; payment/address interaction |
| Secomm_AddressDropdown GraphQL + AJAX cascade | Data quality + N+1 risk on the address dropdown surface |
| Payment UI in Hyvä (VNPAY) | Custom payment UI may differ from Mollie's Hyvä compat bundle |
| Checkout JS events | Mageplaza OSC dispatches its own JS events — do not assume Hyvä/Luma event names |
